suites.boundary: SDK binary-to-text codecs used by keys, addresses, and protocol payloads
suites.target: Base58 and Base58Check arbitrary-byte round trips plus checksum tamper rejection
invariants: Every non-empty byte sequence round-trips through Base58.
Every prefix and payload round-trips through Base58Check.
A deterministic checksum mutation is rejected.

suites.target: Authenticated action-batch pack framing, zero-copy decode, and trailing-data rejection
invariants: Arbitrary bounded blob sets retain exact digests and bytes.
Decoded payloads remain zero-copy views into the authenticated pack.
Trailing bytes are rejected.

suites.boundary: Overlay Mandala linkage payloads and issuer authorization
suites.target: Overlay linkage serialization and exact issuer-allowlist membership
invariants: Arbitrary structured linkage payloads retain exact UTF-8 JSON content.
Issuer admission matches exact allowlist membership.

suites.boundary: DID, multibase, base64url, JSON, and SD-JWT compact encodings
suites.target: Identity codec round trips, canonical alphabets, malformed-input rejection, and SD-JWT framing
invariants: Arbitrary bytes round-trip through base64url and non-empty bytes round-trip through base58-btc multibase.
Arbitrary JSON retains its canonical JSON semantics through base64url encoding.
Malformed base64url encodings are rejected.
SD-JWT fields round-trip with and without key binding.

suites.boundary: Bitcoin script-number and on-chain asset outpoint encodings
suites.target: Safe-integer script numbers, minimal chunks, uint32 outpoints, and truncation rejection
invariants: Every safe integer round-trips through script-number bytes and minimal chunks.
Every 32-byte transaction ID and uint32 output index round-trips.
Non-hex IDs and overflowing output indexes are rejected.

suites.boundary: Public Paymail alias and DNS-name parser
suites.target: Valid address separation, separator ambiguity, DNS label boundaries, and parser totality
invariants: Valid aliases and domains are separated without normalization loss.
Multiple separators and invalid DNS label boundaries are rejected.
Arbitrary untrusted strings never make the parser throw.

suites.boundary: Untrusted Teranode GossipSub UTF-8, JSON, and base64 envelopes
suites.target: Nested payload round trips, tolerant-decoder totality, canonical base64, and runtime envelope shape
invariants: Independent UTF-8 and base64 encoders round-trip arbitrary structured payloads.
The tolerant decoder never throws for arbitrary wire bytes.
Malformed base64 and non-object topic payloads are rejected.

suites.boundary: Authentication signature canonicalization, body binding, and freshness validation
suites.target: Typed-array slice fidelity, deterministic body binding, freshness windows, and malformed-shape totality
invariants: Typed-array views bind only their selected bytes.
JSON request bodies have deterministic signed bytes.
Bodyless and empty-body proofs remain domain-separated.
Freshness checks accept exactly well-formed in-window data without throwing.

suites.boundary: Public chain-reorg SSE framing and height/hash normalization
suites.target: Reorg normalization, bounded depth fallback, numeric validation, SSE framing, and parser totality
invariants: Valid reorg hashes are canonicalized and common-ancestor heights are honored.
A common ancestor cannot exceed the new chain tip.
Depth fallback never produces a negative rebuild height.
Non-safe heights are rejected.
Complete and partial SSE frames are separated without data loss.

suites.boundary: Untrusted overlay-advertised Message Box network destinations
suites.target: HTTPS canonicalization, endpoint composition, reserved-address rejection, idempotence, and totality
invariants: Public HTTPS destinations canonicalize idempotently.
Endpoint paths cannot replace the chosen authority.
Reserved IPv4 and IPv6 destinations are rejected.
Arbitrary advertisements never throw at the tolerant boundary.

suites.boundary: Mobile/deep-link wallet pairing URI trust bootstrap
suites.target: Encoded-field round trips, explicit scheme allowlists, canonical expiry/origin checks, key validation, and totality
invariants: Arbitrary valid pairing fields round-trip exactly.
Custom URI schemes require explicit allowlisting.
Non-canonical expiry values and invalid curve points are rejected.
Arbitrary scanned text never throws.

suites.boundary: BRC-87 names and BRC-101 public service advertisements
suites.target: Name grammar, transport schemes, JS8 geographic/measurement bounds, and parser totality
invariants: Generated BRC-87 names match the exact lowercase grammar.
Every supported public transport scheme accepts canonical destinations.
JS8 measurements are complete positive values within geographic bounds.
Arbitrary advertisement strings never throw.

suites.boundary: Overlay BASM/TAC integrity hashing and untrusted log serialization
suites.target: Block-index ordering, case normalization, deterministic integrity hashes, malformed hashes, and log-forgery resistance
invariants: BASM roots depend on block index rather than input record order.
BASM and TAC hashing is case-insensitive and deterministic.
Malformed hashes are rejected.
Arbitrary JSON serializes into one forge-resistant log field.

suites.boundary: Native BDK batch memory framing, offsets, flags, and result decoding
suites.target: Typed-array packing, offset boundaries, result-pair decoding, malformed lengths, and flag counts
invariants: Arbitrary typed-array batches retain exact bytes and monotonic boundaries.
Arbitrary signed result pairs round-trip exactly.
Wrong flat-result lengths and mismatched flag counts are rejected.

suites.boundary: BTMS wallet metadata, message bodies, labels, and key-derivation instructions
suites.target: JSON metadata, message totality, exact label stripping, typed derivation fields, and context-preserving rejection
invariants: Arbitrary JSON metadata retains its canonical JSON semantics.
Valid derivation instructions round-trip with exact key material.
Non-string derivation material is rejected with UTXO context.
Arbitrary message text never escapes the tolerant parser.

prerequisites: Select one exact suite and inspect it before execution.
Provide only the explicitly documented wallet environment, database, network, and credentials.
Use isolated test identities and disposable data unless the suite explicitly documents a production diagnostic.
manualPolicies.expectedResult: The selected suite completes its assertions without an unhandled error; diagnostic-only or destructive cases require an operator to record the observed result.
manualPolicies.cleanup: Destroy created wallets and storage handles, remove disposable databases/files, and verify no funded or production identity was mutated unexpectedly.
manualPolicies.cadence: Run the relevant suite before a release that changes its boundary and during an operator investigation; do not batch-run all operator suites.

prerequisites: The caller accepts external-network timing and availability variance.
manualPolicies.expectedResult: Both network tips and headers are internally consistent and the SSE subscription returns a valid header.
manualPolicies.cleanup: Unsubscribe the SSE listener and clear its timeout.
manualPolicies.cadence: Weekly and before a release that changes the Go Chaintracks client.

prerequisites: Public Arcade mainnet and teratestnet endpoints are reachable.
No cookie credential or private API key is configured.
manualPolicies.expectedResult: Current headers and the known mined proof are returned and validate against the public Chaintracks provider.
manualPolicies.cadence: Weekly and before a release that changes Overlay provider integration.

prerequisites: At least 2 GiB of free memory is available.
The run is isolated from the normal PR suite.
manualPolicies.expectedResult: AES-GCM encrypts and decrypts a payload larger than the 2^32-bit boundary without truncation.
manualPolicies.cleanup: Allow the process to release the allocated typed arrays; no persistent resource is created.
manualPolicies.cadence: Before an SDK release that changes AES-GCM length handling and on a monthly resource-test run.
